// The A3 ban list, counted when a literal STARTS with a phrase (after an optional era gate and an opening
// quote or bracket), in every literal, short ones too, and case-sensitively. 14 in this file.
export const HITS = [
  'Good call. Your organs send their thanks.',
  "Look at you, being a good person.",
  `Dear ${name}, here's what your CEOs did this year`,
  'You matter',
  'honestly? That is the whole plan.',
  'Note that this is fine.',
  'Consider the offer.',
  'You might want to sit down.',
  'Feel free to leave.',
  "Let's go!",
  'Let’s go!', // a curly apostrophe is straightened first
  `Welcome to ${town}! Please enjoy the stay.`,
  '"Look at you," said Mom.', // an opening quote is skipped
  '@1950 Good call, said the vendor.', // an era gate is skipped
]

// None of these count.
export const MISSES = [
  'You said Good call to the vendor.', // not at the start
  'good call, said the vendor to me.', // case-sensitive
  `Dear ${name}, here is what happened.`, // not "here's what"
  'Welcome to the club, friend', // "Welcome to ...!" needs the exclamation mark
  // The audit's gate pattern has no colon, so it does not look past a "@1998,own:mobilePhone " gate.
  '@1998,own:mobilePhone Good call, said the vendor.',
]
